body:
Founder follow-up: 'make sure the skrip uses claude continue or whateva.' Added --continue to all three claude invocations in tmux-session.sh so a re-run after a dropped connection resumes prior context instead of starting blank, per THE_EMILY_WAY.md Principle 11. Commit 3206cd0, pushed to MONOREPO.

⚓ ☃
title: tmux-session.sh — add --continue per Principle 11
